name: Kydele, Chosen of Kruphix
oracle_text:
Partner (You can have two commanders if both have partner.)
{T}: Add {C} for each card you've drawn this turn.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Add {C} for each card you've drawn this turn.

Scope: variable mana ABILITIES now ship -- an `add_mana` inside a mana ability may carry an `amount` value expression, evaluated at activation (see `tests/unit/test_variable_mana_ability.py`). Eight sibling cards were repaired by that change. Kydele is the one it does not reach, and for a different reason: its multiplier is not a board count. `{"count": <selector>}` counts objects, and "cards you've drawn this turn" is a per-turn tally of an *event*, which the engine does not keep. This card was previously in the pool tapping for a flat {C} with no note recorded against it; it now refuses rather than shipping a Kydele that is strictly worse than the printed one.

needs.what: a per-turn tally of how many cards a player has drawn, readable as a value expression -- e.g. `{"cards_drawn_this_turn": "you"}` -- reset during cleanup, and incremented by every draw whatever caused it (draw step, spell, ability, or a replacement that draws). Kydele spells it `{"op": "add_mana", "mana": "{C}", "amount": {"cards_drawn_this_turn": "you"}}` and needs nothing else, because the variable mana ability machinery it plugs into already ships.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `VALUE_KEYS` has no event tally of any kind. `count` walks a zone and counts objects, so the closest spelling -- counting the hand -- is a different number the moment anything is played, discarded or drawn on an opponent's turn. `cards_in_hand` has the same problem for the same reason. Nothing on `PlayerState` records draws: the fields are life, zones, mana, land drops, commander tax/damage, loss and UI flags, and none of them is a per-turn counter. The `draw` EventType exists and is emitted, so the tally has a natural place to be incremented, but no state to be incremented into and no cleanup hook resetting it. This is the same shape of missing bookkeeping as `damaged-by-source-this-turn` -- a per-turn ledger keyed by player rather than by object -- and whichever ships first should decide where per-turn counters live.
